---
title: "Straight"
sidebar: get-started
---

`straight` delegates to GDSFactory's straight path with OrcaPen's
[`cpw_6_7_6`](../cross-sections.qmd#cpw_6_7_6) cross-section by default.

## Build the default component

```python
import gdsfactory as gf
from orcapen_sc_pdk import activate

activate()
component = gf.get_component("straight")
```

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | 10 µm | Path length. |
| `npoints` | 2 | Number of path points. |
| `cross_section` | `cpw_6_7_6` | Cross-section used to extrude the path. |
| `width` | `None` | Optional width passed to GDSFactory. |

## Ports and layers

The selected cross-section defines the path sections, layers, and connection
ports. See the [cross-section guide](../cross-sections.qmd) for the default
recipe and the [pinned public source](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/0bd9a9e1e8e21d6519f22373f20ef5ce22772a5b/orcapen_sc_pdk/cells/layout/primitives.py)
for the factory definition.
